card.name: Linking words before risk phrases
card.fires_on: Small linking words (to, of, are) just before a stated risk or harm to avoid, such as 'to reduce the risk of' or 'are at an increased risk'. Also seen on a word right before a named adverse effect.

modes.label: Purpose 'to' before avoiding harm
modes.description: The word 'to' introduces a step taken to reduce or avoid a harm.
modes.example: tablets with an insulin secretagogue (e.g., sulfonylurea) or insulin may require lower dosages of the insulin secretagogue and insulin<< to>> reduce the risk of hypoglyc

modes.label: 'are' or 'of' before risk
modes.description: A verb or 'of' linking a patient group or cause to an increased risk.
modes.example: .1 Increased Mortality in Elderly Patients with Dementia-Related Psychosis Elderly patients with dementia-related psychosis treated with antipsychotic drugs<< are>> at an increased risk of death. Anal

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words meaning prevent or guard against, and away from words meaning lose or fall into.
card.plain: It fires on small words right before the text says what harm to prevent or what risk exists.
